let meets_substantial_presence_test (days_current_year : int) (days_1st_preceding_year : int) (days_2nd_preceding_year : int) : bool =
  (* 7701(b)(3)(A)(ii): weighted sum of days present, multipliers 1, 1/3, 1/6 *)
  let weighted_days_sum =
    float_of_int days_current_year *. 1.0 +.
    float_of_int days_1st_preceding_year *. (1.0 /. 3.0) +.
    float_of_int days_2nd_preceding_year *. (1.0 /. 6.0)
  in
  (* (i) at least 31 days in current year, and (ii) weighted 3-year sum >= 183 days *)
  days_current_year >= 31 && weighted_days_sum >= 183.0

(* 7701(b)(3)(D): day not counted as US presence if exempt individual or medical-emergency-bound *)
let is_exempt_presence_day
    (is_exempt_individual : bool)
    (unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition_arising_during_presence : bool)
  : bool =
  is_exempt_individual || unable_to_leave_due_to_medical_condition_arising_during_presence

(* 7701(b)(3)(C): (B) closer-connection exception disallowed if individual sought permanent-resident status *)
let closer_connection_exception_inapplicable
    (has_pending_adjustment_of_status_application : bool)
    (has_taken_steps_toward_permanent_residency : bool)
  : bool =
  has_pending_adjustment_of_status_application || has_taken_steps_toward_permanent_residency

(* 7701(b)(3)(B): exception to substantial presence test -- <183 days current year, foreign tax home, closer connection abroad *)
let has_closer_connection_exception
    (is_present_less_than_183_days : bool)
    (sec_911_d_3 : bool) (* cross-ref: §911(d)(3) -- tax home in foreign country, without regard to second sentence *)
    (has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country : bool)
  : bool =
  is_present_less_than_183_days && sec_911_d_3 && has_closer_connection_to_foreign_country
